answer: Require every new agent identity to be co-signed by three independent, already-established agents who each lock a stake that is slashed if the newcomer is later proven fake. A would-be sybil farmer must therefore bribe or compromise three separate reputations per fake identity, and the cost spirals with each clone. A public randomness beacon picks which established agents audit each newcomer, so no attacker can plant a friendly island of colluding reviewers around their own identities; audits are checkable on-ledger against the stake locks.
